title: Cross-functional initiative dependency matrix and company OKR cadence playbook
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Goal: produce a single source of truth (dependency matrix + cadence playbook) that maps company-level OKRs to active initiatives, engineering epics, design milestones, and operational owners. This ticket covers: 1) building the dependency matrix CSV and import into the roadmap tool; 2) defining a repeatable cross-functional cadence for initiative readiness and weekly/monthly syncs; 3) a playbook for resolving conflicts (priority flips, resource contention) and scoring rollout risk. The output should enable a clear escalation path, automated status rollups for exec review, and a dashboard showing OKR progress tied to initiative delivery. Acceptance criteria and success metrics are below.
acceptance_criteria: Dependency matrix created with columns: OKR, Initiative, Owner (PM), Engineering Epic(s), Design Milestone(s), Blockers, Estimated ship quarter, Risk score
Matrix imported into roadmap tool (Aha/Notion/Linear view) and visible to execs with filtering by OKR and owner
Playbook documented in Confluence with cadence (pre-cycle readiness checklist, weekly initiative sync template, monthly exec rollup), and published link shared to PM/ENG/DES channels
Two pilot initiatives (one infra: Dedicated autoscaling; one product: Structured outputs) used to validate the flow end-to-end, with lessons incorporated
Dashboard tiles created in Looker/Grafana that surface percent completion for company OKRs derived from initiative rollups
